summary: Brother and sister rappelling into Zapata Falls canyon; sister stranded when her rope proved too short to reach the canyon floor, trapped on a ledge above the main falls after wading the partially frozen creek; AVSAR high-angle techs set anchors, lowered a rescuer with dry clothes, and she ascended a belayed rope back out; escorted to the trailhead uninjured
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR; Alamosa County Sheriff's Office
notes: AVSAR 2012 archive narrative; ASO deputy + local climber first on scene; ~1600 hours dispatch
